subject.title: feat(matrix): add configurable read receipt timing

question: Should OpenClaw expose `channels.matrix.readReceiptMode` with `immediate`, `on-reply`, and `off`, including per-account overrides, as a supported Matrix operator policy?
rationale: The patch adds a durable public configuration surface rather than repairing an established broken contract, and the canonical related issue is already waiting for maintainer product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the Matrix policy
options.body: Approve the additive three-mode policy while retaining `immediate` as the default, then require live Matrix proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Choose a smaller supported contract, such as only a global opt-in `on-reply` mode, before implementation is accepted.

options.title: Keep this out of the bundled plugin
options.body: Decline adding this configuration policy to OpenClaw and leave the behavior for operator-local or external plugin customization.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Matrix policy
recommendation.body: Approve the additive three-mode policy while retaining `immediate` as the default, then require live Matrix proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: A concrete Matrix feature-history owner could not be established from the available read-only inspection after the command sandbox failed.
